title: Tipping the balance: NRF2’s dual role in ferroptotic fate
task: Elucidate NRF2 dual role in ferroptosis regulation across cellular contexts
key_results: Review synthesis: NRF2 activates antioxidant defenses (promoting chemoresistance) yet simultaneously regulates ferroptosis-related genes (glutathione, lipid metabolism, iron homeostasis); context-dependent effects vary by cell type and metabolic state

hypotheses.hypothesis: Consensus transcriptional activity among coinfecting phages is required for lysogeny
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: lysogenic cells display consensus activity across all phages; lytic cells contain heterogeneous phage activity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Intracellular viral replication drives divergent fate decisions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: viral replication is necessary for emergence of distinct lytic vs lysogenic transcriptional patterns
